title: Roof Replacement in Portland, OR
summary: In November 2025, French Roofing replaced the roof on a home in Portland, OR. The crew tore off two layers of old roofing down to the wood deck, laid new synthetic underlayment, and installed CertainTeed Landmark shingles with new drip edge, vent pipe flashings and attic vents.
scope: Tore off both layers of old roofing down to the wood deck
Installed Titanium X30 synthetic underlayment over the deck
New painted drip edge and gable flashing, plus a self-sealing starter course
Installed CertainTeed Landmark shingles with standard ridge cap
New sidewall flashing, new flashing at the power mast and new double-seal vent pipe flashings
Replaced the attic vents with new plastic vents
Cleaned out the gutters, hauled away the debris and ran a magnet over the yard
body: This one had two layers of roofing on it, so everything came off before anything new went on. The photos below follow the job from tear-off, to the new underlayment, to the new shingles going on.

faqs.question: How many layers of old roofing came off on this Portland job?
faqs.answer: Two. Both layers came off down to the wood deck, so the new underlayment and shingles went on a clean deck instead of on top of old roofing.

faqs.question: What shingles went on?
faqs.answer: CertainTeed Landmark architectural shingles, over synthetic underlayment, finished with standard ridge cap.
